paper_title: Searching for axion-like particles with ultra-peripheral heavy-ion collisions
coupling_convention: 1/Λ in GeV^-1 (converted to g_agamma in GeV^-1 using g_agamma = 1/Λ)
notes: Paper presents projected sensitivity curves for ALP-photon coupling (aF̃F operator) from ultra-peripheral Pb-Pb collisions at the LHC. The main result is a sensitivity projection for 1 nb⁻¹ integrated luminosity (green solid curve in Fig. 4, left panel). Data points extracted from the projected sensitivity curve for the 1 nb⁻¹ scenario. The coupling is expressed as 1/Λ in the paper; converted to g_agamma using the standard relation g_agamma = 1/Λ. The paper also presents recasted exclusion limits from LEP II (OPAL) and LHC (ATLAS, CMS) for comparison, but the primary new result is the UPC projection. Confidence is moderate (0.75) because the exact numerical values were read from a figure rather than extracted from a table, introducing some uncertainty in the precise coupling values. The paper also discusses the aB̃B operator (right panel of Fig. 4), but the primary focus and strongest constraints are on the aF̃F coupling shown in the left panel. | selector: text (sole candidate)
